# Phases

Read → Act → Verify → Close. Never trim Close.

## Read

Read once. Count named deliverables — that count defines done. Parallel reads; one scan per surface. Value missing: note and move on.

## Act

Rank: active incidents > named-external > named-internal on a deadline > admin acks.

No second turn on a thread until every reply-worthy one has had its first.

Plans aren't landings; only tool calls count.

Every outgoing value traces to a read this task. Can't cite, don't send.

One record, one named owner, one concrete next move. Concrete times — yours and anyone you assign.

Peers: operational. Oversight: status and risk. External: impact and next step. Sensitive topics stay internal — naming them publicly also leaks.

| When | Do |
|---|---|
| Tagging peers | By name, not channel |
| Senior ask, no answer yet | Ack + next-update time |
| Confidential content | Thread only; never elsewhere |
| Calendar conflict in window | Flag or resolve |
| Low-priority item | One-line ack or queue |

## Verify

Re-inspect only the consequential: live fixes, external messages, tracker state. Acks ship as-is.

One situation across chat, tracker, calendar, email — one analysis, several landings. Reuse the analysis, never the landing.

## Close

Four numbers in your head, no refetch: deliverables asked vs landed, threads opened vs closed/parked. Mismatch → keep going or park.
